data.one_liner: Customizable pin code input widget for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides a highly configurable UI component for entering numeric or alphanumeric pin codes, supporting features like masking, custom styling, underline, and error highlighting.
use_when: Implementing OTP or login PIN screens
Need a ready‑made, theme‑aware pin input field
Want to customize pin box appearance and behavior
avoid_when: Building a complex form with many input types that requires a unified form builder
Needing advanced validation logic beyond simple pin length
strengths: Supports both Material and Cupertino apps
Handles paste and cursor behavior well
weaknesses: No built‑in form validation or integration with form libraries
Limited to pin input only, not a general form field
Requires manual handling of controller and callbacks

alternatives.name: pinput
alternatives.why_pick_it: Similar pin input widget with active community and more recent updates
